statement.title: A. A+B Again?
statement.legend: Given a two-digit positive integer $n$, find the sum of its digits.
statement.input_spec:
The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 90$) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains a single two-digit positive integer $n$ ($10 \leq n \leq 99$).
statement.output_spec: For each test case, output a single integer — the sum of the digits of $n$.
